messages.subject: Quartz — agreed cap table (pre/post)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Attached is the agreed pre/post-money cap table reflecting the £10m round at £10.00 per share — 1,000,000 new Series A shares, taking the investors to 25% on a fully diluted basis (£40m post-money). Ravensworth 20%, Aldridge 5%. The option pool sits at 12.5% post.

Please confirm this matches your model and Aisha's, and we'll lock it as the completion version.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0048
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
